extension.summary: CoreELEC 22 parsers for raw Dolby Vision and HDR10+ metadata payloads.
extension.description: A CoreELEC addon built for CoreELEC 22, running on all of its current Amlogic devices. Parses the DV/HDR sidedata JSON that CoreELEC's Amlogic video player publishes via player.process(video.sidedata), a CoreELEC-specific infolabel not present in stock Kodi (so stock Kodi is not supported): the Dolby Vision RPU, the dvcC/dvvC configuration record, HDR10+ ST 2094-40 dynamic metadata, and the static MDCV/CLL SEI payloads. Stdlib only, no required external dependencies; RPU parsing uses libdovi via ctypes (bundled for aarch64), HDR10+ parsing uses CoreELEC's own libavutil via ctypes (CoreELEC 22's ffmpeg 8.1.2 or 9.0, borrowed at runtime, never bundled). Both sections are None when their engine isn't available.
extension.news:
Initial release.
Parses the raw Dolby Vision and HDR side data that CoreELEC's Amlogic video player publishes on the player.process(video.sidedata) infolabel: the Dolby Vision RPU, the dvcC/dvvC configuration record, HDR10+ ST 2094-40 dynamic metadata, and the static MDCV and CLL payloads.
